f0015.note: Six failures, merged on review from three groups. All live under tests/nightly/single_card/stable_diffusion_xl_base/lora/: crossattndownblock2d (0.53, 0.53, 0.60), crossattnupblock2d (0.99), and unet (0.0057, -0.0035). The UNet is built from those attention blocks, so the severity gradient is error compounding through the network rather than three independent faults — degraded blocks composing into an output uncorrelated with the reference. The first pass split unet from crossattn precisely because the magnitudes differed, which is the same mistake as splitting trino on symptom.
